dense_pile_x_paramount.resolution_hint: Frontal lighting flattens pile fabrics like velvet. Use side or rim lighting.

anisotropic_x_softbox.resolution_hint: Soft light destroys the directional microcontrast of anisotropic materials (like brushed metal or silk). Use hard point sources.

luxury_x_wide_angle.resolution_hint: Luxury typically uses high compression (85mm+) for subject isolation. Ensure wide angle is used intentionally for environmental context.

streetwear_x_macro.resolution_hint: Streetwear relies on environmental context. Macro isolates too much.

deep_warm_x_teal_lift.resolution_hint: Teal shadow lifts can make deep, warm skin tones appear ashen or green. Suggest warm sandstone or neutral.
